title: Star knob
about: A clamping knob for an M8 bolt, like on a jig or a camera stand: a hub with five round lobes to turn it by. One lobe is joined on, and a circular pattern repeats it; the bolt hole goes through the middle.
picture_alt: A five-lobed star knob with a hole through its middle
steps: sketch.constrain sketch=HubSketch kind=radius on=Circle1 value=12 name=Hub
sketch.constrain sketch=LobeSketch kind=radius on=Circle1 value=5 name=Lobe

change.about: make the lobes fatter, 6 mm radius instead of 5 mm (LobeSketch's Lobe): all five change, because the pattern repeats the one.
